name: op_v4

brief.wiki: 바랜 옛 병원 간판이 붙은 무면허 의원. 플라스틱 의자, 오래된 잡지, 접수 창구, 진료실 두 개, 그리고 형광등이 쨍한 진짜 수술실이 있다. 수술실은 강박적으로 깨끗하다. 뒷벽에는 이중 잠금 약품장과 사람 하나 들어갈 만한 냉장고가 있는데, 원장은 이걸 \"검체 보관\"이라고 부른다. 그 말투가 질문을 끝내는 말투라서 아무도 더 묻지 않는다.\n[Paragraph]원장 ➡
brief.design: 설계안 jr_op: 바닥 PVC 청회, 벽 흰 타일, 쨍한 조명, 수술대(2.0×0.7×0.9, 긴 옆면이 화면 쪽), 무영등(천장), 이중 잠금 약품장 B02, 사람 하나 들어갈 냉장고(0.9×0.9×1.9), 기구 트레이 ×2, 강박적으로 깨끗(바닥 반사)

place: a cramped, obsessively clean operating room of an unlicensed clinic in a run-down 1990s Seoul underground arcade
floor: blue-grey tiles, dark grout, a drain, mop streaks, a pool of light under the table
walls: white tiles, yellowed grout, a few chipped tiles, steel baseboard; two fluorescent tubes

items.text: center: a steel operating table on one pedestal, long side to camera, 190 by 85 pixels, wrist straps
above it a two-headed surgical lamp on a ceiling arm
left of the table an IV stand, right of it a monitor on a stand
items.why: 수술실 쓰임(수액·생체 감시), 링거대는 대기실에서 옮김

items.text: beside the table two instrument trolleys
on the back wall left a steel medicine cabinet, 165 pixels tall, bottles behind glass, chained shut
on the back wall a sink under glove boxes
on the back wall right a white fridge big enough for a person, 170 by 80 pixels
on the back wall a yellow sharps box
in the back corner a red biohazard bin
next to the fridge two organ coolers
on the right wall a rack of odd mechanical prosthetic limbs
on the left wall a shelf of disinfectant bottles
at the front left an oxygen tank and a hazard-striped drum
at the front right a suction machine cart

shadow: bright table under the lamp, greyer walls, deep shadows under cabinets, trolleys and table, glossy steel highlights
palette: cold greyed white, steel and blue-grey with blue-black shadows and green, yellow, red accents
